question: In Google Calendar: Set the description of the Engineering hiring calendar on Pacific time to Summer interview schedule for the 2018 cohort.
final:

Which one should I update its description to "Summer interview schedule for the 2018 cohort"? Tell me the number (or "all four"), and I'll make the change.
